feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 5:40am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Tuesday, 02 June 2026 at 5:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A dull start with low cloud and mist/fog patches affecting mainly southern to eastern parts of the island this morning, as well as some outbreaks of rain, heavy at times soon arriving. The afternoon and evening will then become generally drier and brighter, although still with the risk of some scattered showers, possibly heavy at times. Light to moderate west or southwest wind, top temperature 17°C.


##Outlook##

Outbreaks of rain will arrive early on Wednesday morning, possibly heavy at times, before largely clearing away in the afternoon to become brighter with sunny intervals, but still with the risk of scattered showers for the rest of the day. Moderate to fresh west or southwest wind soon backing south or southwest and strengthening, highest temperature 16°C.

Cloudy on Thursday with scattered showers potentially merging into longer spells of rain at times, which only clear overnight into Friday. Moderate to fresh southwest winds and temperatures of 15°C.
